coverEdits.prompt: Edit the supplied animal encyclopedia cover. Preserve this exact species identity, realistic anatomy, coloration and habitat. Recompose the ENTIRE animal and any shell used as shelter into the RIGHT HALF of the landscape canvas. Output 1536x1024. HARD COMPOSITION: every visible part of animal including ALL arm tips, fins, tail etc and shelter shell must lie entirely within x=680 to 1470, y=140 to 890. The left 42 percent of the image MUST contain only quiet natural habitat, no part of animal at all. Subject silhouette center around x=1080 (70%). Animal must be large and clear within that right-side box, include all extremities with background margin. For octopus arrange long arms naturally folded or curled compactly in the right-side area so no tip reaches left. Complete subject must be visible, never crop an appendage at edge. Single naturalistic scene, no frames, no text, no labels, no watermark. This is a scientific illustrative reconstruction.
